decisions.reason: Connector-placement flexibility does not change the DCDC1 voltage, rail role, current rating, or compensation behavior.
The client confirms that the LED connector now belongs to the single integrated board rather than the former main-board architecture.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes, I think they can, now that there is only one board + sensors/buttons/leds which are all easy to position I think there is no issue wherever you put them

value_updates.led_interconnect: JST connector on the single integrated board to the LEDs

decisions.reason: The connector-placement decision does not alter BOM readiness, approved parts, population policies, or the existing integrated-board sourcing preference.
The NTC terminal, J_BAT assignment, and AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior remain unchanged; connector placement is owned by the connector-access Requirement.
